newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo Steel seeks receivership - chairman.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo Steel seeks receivership - chairman.

text.p: Hanbo Steel Corp, a unit of South Korea's Hanbo Group, will file for court receivership on Friday, the Hanbo chairman said.
"We will file for court receivership today," Hanbo chairman Chung Bo-keun told reporters.
Hanbo Steel failed to honour payments of more than five billion won on Thursday after facing financial trouble stemming from excessive facilities investment, bank officials said.
Hanbo officials said the steel maker was saddled with debt totalling 5.7 trillion won.
